caseWatch.title: Case status watch
caseWatch.description: Watch the status of your own cases on the court status pages. Lookups run in the background and you never see a captcha. A changed next date arrives as a proposal; nothing is confirmed for you.
caseWatch.flagOff: Case status watch is not switched on for this workspace.
caseWatch.empty: You are not watching any case status yet. Add a watch from a matter's Proceedings tab.

refresh.label: Refresh status
refresh.failed: Could not check the status. Try again later.

outcome.changed: {count, plural, =0 {The status changed.} one {The status changed; 1 proposal is waiting for you.} other {The status changed; # proposals are waiting for you.}}
outcome.not_found: The court page does not list this case.
outcome.unrecognised: The court page could not be read.
